lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਜਾਂ ਨਿਸਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਓਥੈ ਮੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: isatree purakhai jaa(n) nis melaa othai ma(n)dh kamaahee ||
lines.translation: But when men and women meet in the night, they come together in the flesh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਸਹੁ ਨਿੰਮੇ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਜੰਮੇ ਹਮ ਮਾਸੈ ਕੇ ਭਾਂਡੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maasahu ni(n)me maasahu ja(n)me ham maasai ke bhaa(n)de ||
lines.translation: In the flesh we are conceived, and in the flesh we are born; we are vessels of flesh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਪਾਂਡੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan dhiaan kachh soojhai naahee chatur kahaavai paa(n)de ||
lines.translation: You know nothing of spiritual wisdom and meditation, even though you call yourself clever, O religious scholar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰ ਕਾ ਮਾਸੁ ਮੰਦਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਮਾਸੁ ਚੰਗੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: baahar kaa maas ma(n)daa suaamee ghar kaa maas cha(n)geraa ||
lines.translation: O master, you believe that flesh on the outside is bad, but the flesh of those in your own home is good.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਹੋਏ ਜੀਇ ਲਇਆ ਵਾਸੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh maasahu hoe jeei laiaa vaaseraa ||
lines.translation: All beings and creatures are flesh; the soul has taken up its home in the flesh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਭਖੁ ਭਖਹਿ ਭਖੁ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: abhakh bhakhahi bhakh taj chhodahi a(n)dh guroo jin keraa ||
lines.translation: They eat the uneatable; they reject and abandon what they could eat. They have a teacher who is blind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਸਹੁ ਨਿੰਮੇ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਜੰਮੇ ਹਮ ਮਾਸੈ ਕੇ ਭਾਂਡੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maasahu ni(n)me maasahu ja(n)me ham maasai ke bhaa(n)de ||
lines.translation: In the flesh we are conceived, and in the flesh we are born; we are vessels of flesh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਪਾਂਡੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan dhiaan kachh soojhai naahee chatur kahaavai paa(n)de ||
lines.translation: You know nothing of spiritual wisdom and meditation, even though you call yourself clever, O religious scholar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਸੁ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਮਾਸੁ ਕਤੇਬਂੀ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਮਾਸੁ ਕਮਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maas puraanee maas kateba(n)ee chahu jug maas kamaanaa ||
lines.translation: Meat is allowed in the Puraanas, meat is allowed in the Bible and the Koran. Throughout the four ages, meat has been used.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਜਿ ਕਾਜਿ ਵੀਆਹਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ਓਥੈ ਮਾਸੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaj kaaj veeaahi suhaavai othai maas samaanaa ||
lines.translation: It is featured in sacred feasts and marriage festivities; meat is used in them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਪਜਹਿ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਸੁਲਤਾਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: isatree purakh nipajahi maasahu paatisaah sulataanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Women, men, kings and emperors originate from meat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਓਇ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਤਾਂ ਉਨੑ ਕਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਲੈਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: je oi disahi narak jaa(n)de taa(n) unh kaa daan na lainaa ||
lines.translation: If you see them going to hell, then do not accept charitable gifts from them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਂਦਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਲੈਦੇ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਿਙਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: de(n)daa narak surag laide dekhahu ehu dhingaanaa ||
lines.translation: The giver goes to hell, while the receiver goes to heaven - look at this injustice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਲੋਕ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਪਾਂਡੇ ਖਰਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap na boojhai lok bujhaae paa(n)de kharaa siaanaa ||
lines.translation: You do not understand your own self, but you preach to other people. O Pandit, you are very wise indeed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੂ ਜਾਣੈ ਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਉਪੰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: paa(n)de too jaanai hee naahee kithahu maas upa(n)naa ||
lines.translation: O Pandit, you do not know where meat originated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੋਇਅਹੁ ਅੰਨੁ ਕਮਾਦੁ ਕਪਾਹਾਂ ਤੋਇਅਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਗੰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: toiahu a(n)n kamaad kapaahaa(n) toiahu tribhavan ga(n)naa ||
lines.translation: Corn, sugar cane and cotton are produced from water. The three worlds came from water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੋਆ ਆਖੈ ਹਉ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਹਛਾ ਤੋਐ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: toaa aakhai hau bahu bidh hachhaa toai bahut bikaaraa ||
lines.translation: Water says, "I am good in many ways." But water takes many forms.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਰਸ ਛੋਡਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ete ras chhod hovai sa(n)niaasee naanak kahai vichaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: Forsaking these delicacies, one becomes a true Sannyaasee, a detached hermit. Nanak reflects and speaks. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਾ ਇਕ ਜੀਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau kiaa aakhaa ik jeebh teraa a(n)t na kin hee paaiaa ||
lines.translation: What can I say with only one tongue? I cannot find your limits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad veechaar se tujh hee maahi samaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who contemplate the True Word of the Shabad are absorbed into You, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭਗਵਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik bhagavaa ves kar bharamade vin satigur kinai na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Some wander around in saffron robes, but without the True Guru, no one finds the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: des disa(n)tar bhav thake tudh a(n)dar aap lukaaiaa ||
lines.translation: They wander in foreign lands and countries until they grow weary, but You hide Yourself within them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad rata(n)n hai kar chaanan aap dikhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is a jewel, through which the Lord shines forth and reveals Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaa aap pachhaaniaa guramatee sach samaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Realizing one's own self, following the Guru's Teachings, the mortal is absorbed into Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਬਜਾਰੀਆ ਬਾਜਾਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavaa gaun bajaareeaa baajaar jinee rachaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Coming and going, the tricksters and magicians put on their magic show.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: ik thir sachaa saalaahanaa jin man sachaa bhaaiaa ||25||
lines.translation: But those whose minds are pleased by the True Lord, praise the True One, the Ever-stable Lord. ||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਫਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਵਿਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak maaiaa karam birakh phal a(n)mrit phal vis ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the tree of actions done in Maya yields ambrosial fruit and poisonous fruit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਖਵਾਲੇ ਤਿਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kaaran karataa kare jis khavaale tis ||1||
lines.translation: The Creator does all deeds; we eat the fruits as He ordains. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੀਆਂ ਵਡਿਆਈਆਂ ਅਗੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak duneeaa keeaa(n) vadiaaeeaa(n) agee setee jaal ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, burn worldly greatness and glory in the fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਨੀ ਜਲੀਈਂ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੀਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: enee jaleeee(n) naam visaariaa ik na chaleeaa naal ||2||
lines.translation: These burnt offerings have caused mortals to forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Not even one of them will go along with you in the end. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sir sir hoi nibeR hukam chalaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He judges each and every being; by the Hukam of His Command, He leads us on.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: terai hath nibeR toohai man bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Justice is in Your Hands, O Lord; You are pleasing to my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਬੰਨਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਖਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaal chalaae ba(n)n koi na rakhasee ||
lines.translation: The mortal is bound and gagged by Death and lead away; no one can rescue him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਰੁ ਜਰਵਾਣਾ ਕੰਨੑਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਨਚਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jar jaravaanaa ka(n)nhi chaRiaa nachasee ||
lines.translation: Old age, the tyrant, dances on the mortal's shoulders.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਬੇੜੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਖਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bohith beR sachaa rakhasee ||
lines.translation: So climb aboard the boat of the True Guru, and the True Lord will rescue you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ਭੜਹਾੜੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਖਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: agan bhakhai bhaRahaaR anadin bhakhasee ||
lines.translation: The fire of desire burns like an oven, consuming mortals night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਾਥਾ ਚੁਗੈ ਚੋਗ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਛੁਟਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: phaathaa chugai chog hukamee chhutasee ||
lines.translation: Like trapped birds, the mortals peck at the corn; only through the Lord's Command will they find release.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਨਿਖੁਟਸੀ ॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: karataa kare s hog kooR nikhutasee ||26||
lines.translation: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass; falsehood shall fail in the end. ||26||
